description: This Java class models a key mapping element within the OFBiz entity framework, representing mappings between entity fields and related entity fields, with XML serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: ModelKeyMap
classes.description: Immutable class representing a key mapping between entity fields, with XML serialization, comparison, and equality methods.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from field names, with relFieldName defaulting to fieldName if null.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from an XML element, extracting attributes for field names.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity field.

methods.name: getRelFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related entity field.

methods.name: makeKeyMapList
methods.description: Factory methods creating lists of ModelKeyMap instances with varying numbers of mappings.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on fullName.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the object to an XML element.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two ModelKeyMap instances based on fullName.
